description: Header token on an Access List. The token value is never returned.

header_name.description: Request header carrying the token. Can't be a header used for the request itself (such as Host or Cookie) or one NPM sets (X-Real-IP, X-Forwarded-*, X-NPM-Gate-*).

forward.description: Pass the header on to the upstream

last_used_on.description: Date and time the token was last used
